title: Earth surface for the timeline globe
source: NASA Earth Observatory Blue Marble: Next Generation, September 2004, base map with topography and bathymetry
cloudSource: NASA Earth Observatory, The Blue Marble (2002), multi-day MODIS cloud composite
credit: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Reto Stöckli and Robert Simmon
treatment: Recolored land and oceans, enhanced shorelines, composited the static cloud layer, and encoded at 1280 by 640 as WebP. The renderer projects this reference texture and calculates daylight for the selected UTC instant.
